desc: Parse N, M, X and the edge list, and build adjacency lists for both normal and reversed moves.
Construct the two-layer state graph with 2N states and orientation-switch edges of weight X.
Implement the complete solver: build two-layer graph, run Dijkstra with heapq from state (1,0), output min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1]) using fast I/O and 0-indexed vertices.
Verify against all four provided samples (outputs 4, 3, 4294967299, 21) and confirm answers exceeding 32-bit range are handled.
Sanity-check edge cases: unreachable orientation, multiple flips, large X, and N=2 minimal graphs.
